_comment: THE FAMILY FOLD (#1825). Two stats windows beside pr-payloads.json and friction-keys.json, driven by assertAcceptance directly (statsFindings is pure over injected inputs) because their pins are shape assertions on one window each, not counts over the whole class. Every verdict comment carries the full 40-hex head the wave grammar requires and names its own pull request's number padded to 40 hex, so no rework row (head-moved, repair) is in play -- the class words are what these windows are about, and they are words VERDICT_CLASSES never taught, which is exactly why the histogram keys them raw as their own rows.
_acceptance_comment: The acceptance window reproduces both measured holes in miniature. VERDICT half: mutation 2, mutation-vacuous 1, mutation-survivor 1 -- every exact id below the threshold of 3 -- while the family the four pull requests compose sits at 4 distinct pull requests, over it. FRICTION-ID half: the environment family lives in the id histogram, not the verdict histogram (measured: the since-v6.7.13 sweep shows no `environment` verdict row and a 4/5 `environment` id row), so the same shape is composed with friction ids -- environment 2, seat-environment 2, the family at 4, each id below. Each half must print exactly one family would-open line and no exact-id line.
_controls_comment: The controls window carries the null controls in one window. (1) NO DOUBLE-COUNT: 9305 carries both a mutation and a mutation-vacuous verdict, so the naive fold reads 4 over three pull requests -- the family must fire on the UNION, exactly one line, at 3; and mutation's own exact id is at 3 here (over threshold), so the window also pins that the id line and the family line each fire once, not one per member. (2) QUIET STAYS QUIET, both maps: environment (9308, verdict and id) + seat-environment (9309) compose families at 2 distinct pull requests, below threshold, which must print no family line on either kind.

_double_comment: THE DOUBLE COUNT (#2410, measured by #2561 section 6). The window #2561 recorded read the family at 7 while mutation-vacuous filed its own line at 5 of those 7: 5 occasions filed twice. In miniature: mutation-vacuous at 3 (9321-9323) files its own line; mutation (9324) and mutation-survivor (9325) are the only occasions no member line counts, so the family reaches 3 only by re-counting the member's.
